source: Chief Architect X18 Tutorial Guide, Floor Plan Tutorials, pages 60-81

steps.step: Interior stair defaults: 44" wide; 4" BX-02 newels 44" high; white balusters, red oak rails and treads
Newel style and materials in the stair defaults: square newels, white-painted railing
A few steps from the Garage up to the Foyer
steps.gap: The Garage floor isn't lower than the Foyer (no separate garage slab), so there's nothing to step up. Row: FD-07

steps.step: Draw Stairs beside the Dining/Foyer wall, upward: they reach Floor 2 by themselves
Position the stair 4'6" from the front wall by typing on a dimension
Lock the bottom, Make Best Fit, lock the number of treads and make treads 10 1/2" deep
(Lock Bottom / Lock Top / Lock Number of Treads / Make Best Fit)
steps.gap: Stairs always fit the floor above from their start; no lock options or best-fit button. Row: ST-19

steps.step: Back-clipped cross section along the stair, saved as 'Stair Section'
(Tile the plan and section views)
Auto Stairwell: open the stair's dialog and click Auto Stairwell. The floor above is cut and railings go round the opening, open at the top
(The opening on Floor 2 as an Open Below room)
steps.gap: The opening isn't a room of its own (no Open Below room type), so it has no label. Row: ST-18

steps.step: Headroom: an end-to-end dimension in the section from the nosing to the ceiling; move its point marker
steps.gap: Point markers on dimension ends in section views can't be moved; use a manual dimension. Row: SEC-06

steps.step: Stack the stairs: copy, go to Floor 0, Paste Hold Position. They reach Floor 1
Tape Measure the clearance at the bottom of the basement stair (Dimension tools › Tape Measure)
Turn off the Stairs & Ramps layer while editing the stairwell
(Turn railings into walls; Same Wall Type handle)
steps.gap: No Same Wall Type handle; open each railing and change its wall type. Row: ST-18

steps.step: Section view clip planes: Clip Sides and Clip Elevation, moved to frame the stairs
(Top/bottom clip elevations and clip lines you can drag)
steps.gap: Section views clip at the sides only; no top/bottom clip elevations or draggable clip lines. Row: SEC-01

steps.step: Note schedule (General notes, capsule shape) and a numbered note 'HEADROOM 6' 8" MIN.' at the foot of the stairs
(Make it a numbered note)
Copy the note to Floor 0 with Paste Hold Position; the schedule lists it once
(Note types, Generate Shape from Schedule, capsule markers; CAD Detail Management; align schedules)
steps.gap: No note types or capsule marker (CAD Detail Management and schedules placed in a detail are there). Row: TXT-16

steps.step: Save a copy as Chic Cottage-Stairs
